van_gogh_optB.description: Accepted L-1 reveal-planner stack (commit 789b02a): van_gogh_p option B, 10 sheets, 225 mm outer, 200 mm artwork grid.
van_gogh_optB.rights: Third-party character artwork. Private evaluation only; do not publish or redistribute.
van_gogh_optB.manual_steps: Palette extraction, 2048 px snapping, magenta frame strips and the option A/B colour edits were ad hoc, user-requested preprocessing (technical PDF ch. 3). The target PNG is their saved result; L0 does not regenerate it.
